# Quiet design system

> Calm, dense and precise. Built for dashboards and tools people use all day.

Read DESIGN.md before writing any UI for this product. Install the system with `npx auto-design add <this site>/r/`
and check work with `npx auto-design check`.

## Docs

- [DESIGN.md](DESIGN.md): every rule, role, scale and component, written for coding agents
- [Registry](r/registry.json): shadcn registry items, installable one at a time

## Components

- [Button](r/button.json): Buttons with one primary variant per view.
- [Card](r/card.json): Grouped content on the page.
- [Input](r/input.json): Text input sized to match buttons.
- [Badge](r/badge.json): Status and labels, always with text.
- [Toaster](r/toaster.json): Toasts by Sonner, styled with system tokens.
- [Message](r/message.json): Chat messages and tool-call rows for agent UI.
- [Label](r/label.json): Form labels.
- [Textarea](r/textarea.json): Multi-line text input.
- [Separator](r/separator.json): A hairline between groups.
- [Skeleton](r/skeleton.json): Loading placeholders.
- [Table](r/table.json): Data tables with tabular numbers.
- [Tabs](r/tabs.json): Switch between views of the same thing.
- [Dialog](r/dialog.json): Modal dialogs that enter from the system's enter scale.
- [Switch](r/switch.json): On and off settings.
- [Avatar](r/avatar.json): People and workspaces.
- [Code block](r/code-block.json): Syntax-highlighted code in the system's colors (Shiki, server-rendered).
- [Approval](r/approval.json): The agent asks before it acts: what will happen, and two short answers.
- [Citation](r/citation.json): Inline source numbers and the source list under an answer.
- [Streaming text](r/streaming-text.json): Model output as it arrives, with a caret and screen-reader-safe updates.
- [File card](r/file-card.json): Attachments and generated files, with type, name and size.
- [Reasoning](r/reasoning.json): The agent's thinking, folded away with how long it took.
- [Motion](r/motion.json): Durations, easing, springs and entrance and reveal presets for Motion or the Web Animations API.
